questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes Moore's prediction or Moore's law:

options.text: Every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
The number of components in an IC can never be increased.
The number of components in an IC realized at minimum cost will double every year or every two years.
The sizes of transistors in ICs realized at minimum cost will remain constant.

questions.sourceAnswerText: The number of components in an IC realized at minimum cost will double every year or every two years.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of masks in photolithography:

options.text: Define shapes/patterns that need to be obtained on the wafer.

questions.sourceAnswerText: Define shapes/patterns that need to be obtained on the wafer.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect:

options.text: Multiple dies are fabricated on a single silicon wafer.
Silicon wafers are sliced out from silicon ingots.
We get silicon ingots from a silicon die.

questions.sourceAnswerText: We get silicon ingots from a silicon die.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect:

options.text: The semiconductor manufacturing plant where integrated circuits are fabricated is called a semiconductor foundry.

questions.sourceAnswerText: Designing integrated circuits is done in semiconductor foundries.

questions.prompt: Which among the following design styles require maximum design effort:

questions.prompt: For which of the following figures of merit, dedicated hardware can be better than the same function implemented as software running on a general-purpose processor:

options.text: It gets rid of all the software in the system.

questions.sourceAnswerText: It chooses an optimal combination of hardware and software to implement the system.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of behavior synthesis in VLSI design flow?

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is correct for multilevel logic?

options.text: A multilevel logic representation will always produce a minimum delay between the input and the output.
As the number of levels in a multilevel logic increases, the delay between the input and the output decreases.
A multilevel logic can be transformed to explore various delay-area trade-offs.
A multilevel logic representation cannot be transformed into a two-level logic representation.

questions.sourceAnswerText: A multilevel logic can be transformed to explore various delay-area trade-offs.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about the algebraic model in multilevel logic optimization is incorrect?

options.text: An algebraic model neglects some Boolean properties of the local functions.
An algebraic model treats a variable and its complement as separate variables.
Efficient algorithms can be designed to carry out division in an algebraic model.
An algebraic model can reduce the Boolean expression (a + a') to 1

questions.sourceAnswerText: An algebraic model can reduce the Boolean expression (a + a') to 1

questions.prompt: A minterm is found to be Don't Care (DC) during logic optimization. Which of the following statements best describes the behavior of the logic synthesis tool?

options.text: A logic synthesis tool will implement a circuit that can produce either 0 or 1 for this minterm, depending on which of these values reduces the cost.
A logic synthesis tool will implement a circuit that always produces 0 for this minterm.
A logic synthesis tool will implement a circuit that always produces 1 for this minterm.
A logic synthesis tool will implement a circuit that always produces high impedance (Z value) for this minterm.

questions.sourceAnswerText: A logic synthesis tool will implement a circuit that can produce either 0 or 1 for this minterm, depending on which of these values reduces the cost.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect for a typical sequential circuit implementation of a finite state machine (FSM)

The transition function is implemented using combinational logic.

questions.sourceAnswerText: Reducing the number of states in an FSM can never reduce the size of the circuit implementation.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect about state minimization in a finite state machine (FSM)

options.text: State minimization attempts to derive an FSM with the minimum number of states and exhibiting the same behavior as the original FSM.
State minimization can reduce the number of flip-flops in FSM implementation.

questions.sourceAnswerText: State minimization will change the functionality/behavior of an FSM and should not be done.

questions.prompt: The power dissipated in a CMOS circuit when it is not performing active computation is known as:

options.text: The period of the clock is decreased.
The activity at the input of the circuit element is decreased.

questions.sourceAnswerText: The period of the clock is decreased.

Which of the following statements best describes the problem of using a simple AND gate for clock gating?

It can create glitches at the output of the AND gate, and this glitch can trigger a flip-flop in its fanout.
